description: Sends the server's code as a new version: the server's folder from the project (the default), or source: github to have Ploa take it from the app's linked repository (a commit, or the branch's head). Ploa builds it in the server's Google Cloud with its Dockerfile, or as Node, Python, Go, Java, Ruby, PHP or .NET by itself (package.json's start script, a Procfile...); it must listen on the PORT variable. Then the release command runs, and the new version goes live; the one before stays for rolling back. Returns at once: ploa_server_status says how it went, and ploa_server_logs shows the build and the server's output.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.

folder.description: The server's folder, relative to the app's folder; the server's own setting when not given.

name: ploa_server_deploy
title: Deploy the server's code
